# sax 1.6.1

Unmodified `lib/sax.js`, renamed `sax.cjs` for this ESM application, from the laptop's bundled Node dependencies (bundle 26.1020.11618). Upstream: https://github.com/isaacs/sax-js. License: BlueOak-1.0.0, retained in LICENSE.md. No Odoo code.

Vendored explicitly because this laptop's certificate gateway blocked npm registry installation; TLS verification was not disabled. The application uses strict XML parsing with DTD/entity rejection and bounded input. Do not remove the license or silently update this dependency. A complete dependency/security review remains a release gate.
